{{Top|leg}}
The '''Treaty Recording System''' was a device used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to record their treaty agreements. A standard looking [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]] was mounted on a gyro-stabilized tripod. Any image recorded by the system was processed through a combination of [[RTZ security filter]]s and the recorded on a [[WORM chip]] to ensure that the data could not be modified.
